questions.question: Why did Joshua build an altar to the LORD on Mount Ebal?

answers.text: The LORD's servant Moses had commanded it
The elders of Israel had asked for it
The Levitical priests had asked for it

questions.question: What did Joshua write on the stones at Mount Ebal?

answers.text: A copy of the law of Moses
The names of the twelve tribes
A record of the battle at Ai

questions.question: Half of Israel stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half in front of Mount Ebal. What was this for?
At Mount Ebal, Joshua read the law aloud to Israel, but he left out the curses. True or false?
